name: Heavy assault starfighter
description: A heavy assault starfighter was a type of starfighter used in naval warfare. The B-wing heavy assault starfighter was a series of heavy assault starfighters. The A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter could be outfitted with multiple laser cannons, torpedo launchers, or laser bombs and a composite-beam laser. The ARC-170 starfighter was a reconnaissance starfighter that was also considered a heavy assault fighter.
